central_invariant: A worker in the specified networkless Docker container cannot invoke the separately hosted local-only mock broker without passing kernel SO_PEERCRED UID/GID, independent broker-pinned TEST Ed25519 approval, and durable SQLite first-use consumption. Host runner requests with the wrong peer UID are denied before decoding the request. No real Provider is present.
trusted_broker_execution: separate host subprocess; not independently sandboxed from compromised host
os_config: two exact read-only mounts: worker code and shared test grant/socket
operator_root: test-only locally generated; pinned by host broker subprocess, not by worker
peer_authentication: SO_PEERCRED UID/GID plus signed, source-target-bound, single-use test grant; UID is not unique to one Docker container
nonclaims: No independent production operator trust root
No production Provider credential or egress controls
A host administrator or other process running as UID 65534 with access to the socket is not ruled out by UID alone
Docker daemon and host kernel are trusted assumptions
No challenge-response IPC channel authentication against same UID peer
No proof of complete AgentDojo wire body because mock-only request identifier is used
next: Independently verify precise Docker inspect, exact request and signed grant, raw SQLite, UID/GID peer evidence and CI; do not enable real Provider calls. Later: hardened broker/container credential custody and independently enrolled human approval.
